links.outcome: Odds of all-cause hospitalization within 7 days after risk-triggered case review/intervention
links.effect: AI-driven intervention associated with 8% reduction in odds of 7-day hospitalization (OR=0.92; P=0.025); effective for scores 0.64-0.85, no significant effect above 0.85.
links.quote: AI-driven intervention was associated with an 8% reduction in the odds of hospitalization within 7 days (odds ratio=0.92; P=0.025).
